paper_title: Knowing You Don't Know Learning When to Continue Search in Multi-round   RAG through Self-Practicing
caption: Ablation study on different Inner Monologue turns on HotPotQA. The green line represents the Naive Generation baseline, while the blue line shows the performance of SIM-RAGlite. The red line indicates the EM score using the ground-truth label as an Oracle Critic.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the Exact Match (EM) score in percent as a function of the number of “Turns of Inner Monologue” for three different methods evaluated on HotPotQA, as part of an ablation study. The x-axis, labeled “Turns of Inner Monologue,” ranges from 0 to 6 with integer tick marks and a linear scale. The y-axis, labeled “EM (%)”, spans from 0 to 50 with major gridlines at intervals of 10 and a linear scale. The red line, labeled “SIM-RAG (Oracle Critic),” begins at approximately 20% EM at 0 turns, rises steeply to ~30% at 1 turn, then increases more gradually to ~47% at 6 turns. The blue line, “SIM-RAG (lite),” starts at ~18% EM at 0 turns, climbs to ~22% at 1 turn, and continues to rise steadily to ~30% at 6 turns. The green line, “Naive Gen,” remains flat across all turns, maintaining a constant EM score of approximately 20%. All lines are marked with distinct symbols (red x, blue x, green x) and connected by solid lines.
